checks.explanation: San Francisco's downtown/SoMa office district has not been meaningfully revitalized; office vacancy remained near record highs (around 30%+) through 2024-2025 despite city efforts.

San Francisco's office vacancy rate approached roughly 30%+ by end of 2022 and continued climbing toward the mid-30s in subsequent years, broadly in line with this prediction's magnitude, though the precise 30 million sq ft / 40% figures are approximate.

OPEC+ made various production-quota adjustments through 2022, but Saudi Arabia did not cleanly move from 10 to 11 million barrels per day by August 2022 in the specific manner described; actual Saudi output fluctuated around 10-11 million bpd across the year amid OPEC+ policy shifts.

Oil prices never approached $180-380/barrel; Brent crude stayed in the roughly $70-120 range through 2022 even amid the Russia-Ukraine war and sanctions, as other producers and releases from strategic reserves offset lost Russian supply.

Saudi Arabia's plan to expand capacity toward 12 million bpd by 2027 remains an ongoing multi-year project as of 2026; Aramco later scaled back this specific target in 2024, but full resolution of the original 2024-2027 timeline claim isn't cleanly verifiable either way.

Cap-and-trade and carbon-pricing/border-adjustment mechanisms did expand globally through the 2020s (EU CBAM, expanded carbon markets in various countries), consistent with this general directional prediction.
Jeff Bezos never ran for US president in the 2024 election cycle.
Bezos did not run for president in 2024, confirming Friedberg's counter-prediction.
The 2024 general election was contested by Donald Trump and Kamala Harris, not DeSantis and Bezos; DeSantis lost the Republican primary to Trump and Bezos never ran.
The All-In Podcast continued releasing episodes well past episode 100 and remains active through 2026.
